o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قویمق (qoymaq), from Proto-Turkic *kod-, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *ko-. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (kōd-), [script needed] (kōt-, “to put, to set down, to lay, to place”), Turkish koymak, etc.
Likely derived from Proto-Turkic *kog- (“to hollow”), and is related to qovuq and koğuş (“tree hollow”).
From irs + -iyyət. Compare Ottoman Turkish ارثیت (irsiyet, “the right to inherit”), Turkish ırsiyet (“heredity”).
